performanceRecheck.limitations: Sequential single samples with original all-pass counting overhead. Animation and runtime scheduling continue. No causal attribution to wall shader or environment from variability alone.

performanceConclusions: C14 first aerial drop did not recur in the single authorized repeat: 184 frames/20 over20ms/max30.9ms vs202/0/max15.5ms. Both results retained.
First-run long intervals are approximately two 65Hz presentation intervals, not evidence of a constant58FPS render cost. The normal baseline is not an isolated GPU microbenchmark.
No causal assignment to wall shader, parallel CPU work or environment is supported by these sequential samples. No more repeats requested or performed.

cpuTimingCorrelation.conclusion: Reports have no started/completed timestamps. Stage anchors include setup/warmup/sample/capture and do not isolate exact frame interval; cannot establish precise overlap. File modification times were not substituted for execution timestamps.

visualFindings.finding: Compared original1440PNG to C13: wall blotches visibly reduced; soft residual grain remains and wall becomes brighter. ROI meanLuma177.7621→185.8281/std4.4035→1.5174. This is both brightness and contrast change, not mean-preserving contrast reduction.
Near wall dark specks become much fainter without restoring circular arcs. ROI mean88.6368→93.4250/std.9321→.5444. Props, glass and narrow cap remain in the same composition.
Dark wall mottling is reduced; stair/landing structure and shadows remain legible in this static camera.
shop-interior and service-corner whole PNG bytes and decoded RGB are identical to C13. No generic whole-scene identity claim.

No obvious composition shift. 01 has647 changed pixels/meanAbsRGB.0009164/max9, >1 bbox x708..852/y360..391. street-detail1543 pixels/mean.0029594/max10, >1 bbox x0..86/y92..131. Do not attribute all small changes to cherry animation.

limits: Only default AO .55/time14; no AO-off assertion. All7 capture1/capture2 pairs identical, not a moving-camera shimmer test.

0.93 is a fixed linear mixture target, not measured map mean. The256x256 sRGB texture mean is normalized encoded[.920276,.915775,.902469], EOTF linear[.829067,.819954,.793365]. CPU map means are not filtered GPU sample means.

Actual GL shader was read to hash and check mix; program compilation/link were queried. Full GL fragment text was not retained due a duplicate object key in diagnostic output. SHA256, containsWallMix and actual hook source are retained; no shader-body archive claim.

Current city material is a separate MeshToonMaterial clone; shader hook does not change public material type. It shares original map, station.root does not use the wall clone. No disposal lifecycle test in this GPU run.
Static image-space ROIs are not semantic masks. Final RGB luma is encoded-output weighted RGB, not physical linear luminance.
Transport failures remain in both normal runs; the clean diagnostic does not supersede those failures.
FPS near65 may be display limited and original submission-counter overhead remains.

offlineReproduction.method: Original PNG decoded RGBA by existing FFmpeg; images unmodified. RGB pixel diff thresholds >0/>1/>4. MeanAbsRGB normalized by area*3. ROI luma=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B on encoded8-bit RGB. Frame long threshold strictly ms>20; raw samples preserved with index.
